scoring_justification: Headline quantities result from long Monte Carlo simulations; full recompute in the verifier sandbox is infeasible. Result-level comparison against the paper-reported values is therefore the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Embedded paper-reported critical temperatures, exponents, and transition order as hidden gold.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 (critical temperatures & exponents) and Figs 4,6,7 (transition order).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported values; match the reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values reported in the paper; they are the reproduction target.
